changes.reason: Registered workflow graphs and typed builder definitions retain their declared steps, execution policy and trigger configuration when caller or reader objects are mutated.

kubernetes.reason: Definition snapshots copy and freeze only workflow-owned JavaScript structures. They introduce no host capabilities, storage, transport, initialization or shutdown boundary. Handler targets and resolver functions retain their identity.
constraints: This change does not establish deployment support or provider certification. Existing task execution, retry and cancellation contracts are unchanged.
